text:
michael_cs: Heads-up — NovaHealth reported a sharp drop in rerank relevance after last week's maintenance. They sent 20 examples, ~12% look clearly worse. Customer is asking for priority. :frowning:
priya_pm: Can you paste 2–3 representative queries + before/after results and the time this started? Is it just NovaHealth or more customers?
michael_cs: Pasted 3 samples and session link: https://redwood/sessions/NH-4521. Started around Tue 09:15 UTC after the deploy window.
lina_customer: Confirming. We noticed worse top results and more noise at rank 1–5. This impacts our search CTR and a live workflow. Need ETA for fix.
ben_ml: Looking at the eval traces now. Early hypothesis: combination of a new KV-cache eviction tweak plus the quant-profile change for 6-bit experiment. Running replay on NovaHealth queries.
ben_ml: Quick repro command I ran: `python tools/eval_rerank.py --customer novahealth --slice last7d --metric recall@10` — shows ~11% drop vs our control baseline.
sarah_eng: I can reproduce the same locally against the canary serving image. I've captured serving logs showing different tokenization path for several queries.
michael_cs: Customer wants clear answer: rollback config or model retune? Which is faster?
priya_pm: Product triage proposal: 1) reproduce and confirm root cause, 2) test mitigation (config rollback vs tuned quant), 3) run short canary with acceptance criteria, 4) full rollout with rollback triggers.
jordan_prod: Assigned to product backlog as P0-customer-impact. Acceptance criteria (draft): restore recall@10 for NovaHealth to within 2% of baseline and no >1% regression on control corpora. Also require a runbook for rollback and observed metrics.
ben_ml: I'll prepare a tuned quant profile and a cache param rollback option. ETA: repro + mitigation candidate by EOD tomorrow, patch + canary Wed.
michael_cs: Noted. I've told the customer we'll give status updates every 48 hours and an ETA when root cause is confirmed.
olivia_support: Adding the customer ticket to on-call watchlist and setting SLA escalation to high. :eyes: 
ops_bot: Incident INC-2026-345 created for rerank degradation — priority HIGH.
jordan_prod: If the cause is purely serving config, we can patch quickly. If it needs model retune, schedule hit is ~2 sprints. We'll decide based on the repro run.
priya_pm: I'll draft a short launch/rollback checklist and attach to the incident ticket: criteria, monitoring queries, canary percentages, max allowed regression, contact list.
michael_cs: Please cc me when added. Customer asked to be looped in weekly.
jordan_prod: Will update backlog item with acceptance criteria and rollout plan. Tagging @exec if we need to bump priority further.
ben_ml: Update: reproducible locally, candidate quant profile improves recall@10 back to -1.2% vs baseline on NovaHealth and safe on control. Will open PR with tests now.
michael_cs: Thanks everyone — passing update to NovaHealth.
